chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawah narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Qurashi from Ali ibn Uthman ibn Wazir from Muhammad ibn Furat, uncle of Hammad al-Sayrafi, from Jabr ibn Yazid from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Beware of the false oath, for it leaves the dwellings empty of their residents.'
ai.seo_question: What is the social consequence of taking false oaths according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.s.a.w.s. warns against *al-yamin al-fajirah* (the false or perjurious oath), linking it to divine punishment that causes people to abandon their dwellings. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that false oaths disrupt social stability and invite calamity, serving as a practical deterrent for maintaining communal integrity.
